name: Aerospace Materials
summary: Surveys how materials are chosen, qualified and used in aircraft, rockets and spacecraft, where weight, reliability and temperature dominate.

topics.name: Requirements of aerospace structures: specific stiffness, strength, toughness and damage tolerance
Evolution of airframe materials: wood, aluminium, titanium and CFRP
CFRP airframes (e.g. Boeing 787, Airbus A350) and design considerations
Jet-engine materials by section: fan, compressor, combustor and turbine
Launch-vehicle materials: tanks, thrust structures, engines and fairings
Materials for rocket engines: combustion chambers, nozzles and turbopumps
Spacecraft structural materials and dimensionally stable structures
Design allowables: A- and B-basis values, MMPDS and CMH-17
Materials qualification, certification and process specifications
Aerospace failure case studies and lessons learned
